notes: Fix the Content Type card alignment in Text to Video. The radio + title used align-items:flex-start with a hand-tuned margin-top:3px on the radio to fake vertical centring — fragile across fonts/widths, and when the two descriptions wrapped to different line counts the cards looked unbalanced. Restructured each card to display:block with the radio and title on one flex row (align-items:center, so the radio is always vertically centred on the title), and the description flowing beneath, indented to sit under the title. Also pinned the radio to its native size with width:auto — the global '.modal input { width:100% }' rule was stretching it once it sat in a flex row with flex:none. Verified at 820px and 1200px: both radios share the same top, each is centred on its title, titles aligned, equal card heights.
